summary: Oxbridge Re Holdings Ltd filed an 8-K reporting entry into an At-the-Market Sales Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC as sales agent. The company may sell ordinary shares up to $1,678,301 from its existing shelf registration, paying a 3% commission plus up to $20,000 in legal fees. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes and reinsurance operations. This is a routine at-the-market offering, not a special situation. No deal terms beyond the commission and shelf capacity are provided.
